Recipes already present in the live Classic Era client (e.g. Season of Discovery content, which ships within the classic_era client lineage, not a separate branch) are excluded -- this file is genuinely Forever-specific content only, diffed against Classic Era the same way foreverdiff.com does on this identical build.
